Shadewright {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} is installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} get deployments

Next:
{{- if not .Values.settings.create }}
  - Create the RemediationSettings object named "default" (settings.create=true, or apply your own).
{{- end }}
{{- if not .Values.executor.identity.azure.clientId }}
  - executor.identity.azure.clientId is not set: the executor cannot sign for the GitHub App, so a request that
    reaches the Git step stays Pending.
{{- end }}
{{- if and .Values.metrics.enabled .Values.metrics.secure }}
  - Metrics are scraped only from namespaces labeled "metrics: enabled", by an identity allowed to "get" the
    non-resource URL /metrics (the ClusterRole {{ include "shadewright.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "metrics-reader" "context" $) }}; nothing binds it).
{{- end }}
{{- if not .Values.networkPolicy.enabled }}

WARNING: networkPolicy.enabled=false. The chart installed no NetworkPolicy at all, so the default deny for the
namespace is gone too: every Pod in {{ .Release.Namespace }} can send and receive any traffic unless you restrict it yourself.
{{- end }}
{{- if not .Values.metrics.secure }}

WARNING: metrics.secure=false. The metrics endpoint serves plain HTTP with no authentication. Use it only for a test.
{{- end }}
